subject: english
question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Frekquent."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is **"Frequent"** with a **"u" **instead of an** "e."**
 
• **"Frequent"** means occurring or appearing often, while "Frekquent" is an incorrect spelling of the word. (प्रायः घटित होने वाला, बार-बार होने वाला; बहुल)
 
 
• **Example**: *His visits became less **frequent**__.*
 
 
 
• Other options in the question are spelled correctly.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Coherent"** means (ideas, thoughts, etc.) clear and easy to understand; logical. ((विचार आदि) स्‍पष्‍ट और सुबोध; सुसंगत)
 
• **"Collide" **means to crash; to hit somebody/something very hard while moving. (गतिमान वस्‍तुओं का टकराना; टकराव होना)
 
• **"Ferocious"** means very aggressive and violent. (अति आक्रामक और हिंसक; उग्र व ख़ूनख्‍़वार)

32:T674,

The correct answer is **"Speaking with an eloquent expression to convince people."**
